purpose: Canonical requirements for persistent, sourced country baseline intelligence.
rules: Every country/category combination requires at least one active baseline record.
Every new baseline record requires a real source and SourceObservation.
Baseline content must describe persistent or regularly recurring traveller-relevant conditions; current incidents belong in events.
Seasonal or month-specific information must be included where it materially affects travel, health, packing, transport or operations.
Use multiple independent sources when a single source is insufficient or the subject is consequential.
Do not use AI general knowledge as the source of record; verify claims against the actual source.
Do not use a current event as a substitute for baseline coverage.

minimumContent.SECURITY: Baseline security environment, regional variation, principal threats and practical precautions.
minimumContent.ENTRY: Passport/visa/permit requirements, entry restrictions, customs or other material entry considerations.
minimumContent.HEALTH: Healthcare access, endemic/vector-borne disease considerations, vaccination/medical considerations and practical precautions.
minimumContent.EMERGENCY: Emergency numbers and key emergency-service/access considerations.
minimumContent.TRANSPORT: Principal international gateways, road/ground transport conditions, internal movement and material seasonal/access constraints.
minimumContent.ENVIRONMENT: Climate and seasons, regional variation, natural hazards and operational implications. Include month/season context where useful.
minimumContent.INSURANCE: Country-specific insurance/medical/travel requirements, restrictions and practical coverage considerations.
minimumContent.LAWS_CULTURE: Material laws, customs, behaviour restrictions and cultural considerations affecting personnel.
minimumContent.COMMUNICATIONS: Mobile/internet availability, connectivity restrictions, telecom considerations and backup communications relevance.
minimumContent.FINANCE: Currency, cash/card/ATM availability, banking/payment constraints and practical financial considerations.
minimumContent.LANGUAGE: Official and widely used languages plus operationally useful language considerations.
minimumContent.ACCOMMODATION: Operational accommodation considerations including security, location, utilities, backup power/water and standards relevant to personnel.
minimumContent.EQUIPMENT: Country/environment-specific personal and operational equipment considerations, including seasonal needs.
minimumContent.TRAINING: Relevant pre-deployment or recurrent training considerations such as first aid, defensive driving, HEAT, 4x4 or environmental training where justified.

sourcePriority: UK/US/Canada/Australia/NZ government travel and health sources
national meteorological, health, aviation, transport and emergency authorities
seasonalRule: Do not provide a generic climate sentence where seasonal conditions materially change what a traveller should expect or pack.
